anya: FYI ran a targeted perf sweep against the kernel picker after the flash/sdpa merge. seeing a ~22% p50 regression for causal runs when head_dim % 16 != 0 (hit with head_dim=30) :confused:

sam: ugh. is this on SM80 or SM90?

anya: primarily SM80 machines in CI cluster-2. SM90 looks mildly better but still worse than before. p50 from 88ms -> 108ms on our 2k token synthetic trace. p99 also +15%

dmitri: can you paste the repro command and the selector log?

anya: sure:
```
# repro (dockerized repro harness)
./perf_harness --model=redwood-small --seq=2048 --batch=1 --head_dim=30 --causal=true --cache-warm=true
```
selector log snippet:
```
[2026-03-10T14:02:12Z] kernel_picker: chosen=flash_v3_causal_tile, fallback=sdpa_v2_noncausal, probe_latency=1.8ms
[2026-03-10T14:02:12Z] kernel_picker: heuristic_score=0.43, kv_cache_hit=true
```

maria: is the picker preferring flash_v3 due to an optimistic probe but then actually executing a slower path because of head-slice alignment?

anya: that’s my suspicion. probe chooses based on micro-benchmark on zeroed inputs; with kv-cache and real attention masks, the runtime ends up in a slower kernel path (extra memcpy for causal pad handling).

sam: can we add a quick guard: if head_dim % 16 != 0 and causal && kv_cache_hit -> bias towards sdpa_v2?

dmitri: i'd prefer adding a hysteresis to the picker rather than hard rules. probe results should be combined with empirical runtime traces (last N requests) to avoid flip-flopping.

anya: i collected perf-bot traces attached below (summaries):
- flash_v3_causal_tile: p50 108ms p99 220ms tokens/sec 450
- sdpa_v2_causal: p50 89ms p99 195ms tokens/sec 560
- flash_v2_noncausal: p50 95ms p99 205ms tokens/sec 520

perf-bot: automated_profile: job=kernel_probe_297111, status=complete, artifacts=/artifacts/297111/kernel_probe.tgz :robot_face:

maria: given those numbers i agree with preferring sdpa_v2 for this workload. but we should generalize: detect when probe latency diverges from recent real latencies and decay probe confidence.

sam: also check microbatching interplay. when we enabled continuous batching last week, batch sizes sometimes jump to 2 for long seq traces and that changes alignment and which kernel wins.
\
dmitri: good call. head_dim 30 with batch=1 -> worst. batch=2 might pad to 32 per matmul and then flash wins. we need sequence-dependent heuristics: consider (head_dim, batch, seq_len, causal_flag) jointly.

anya: created issue: https://redwood.company/issue/INF-4231 Kernel-picker: probe-vs-real hysteresis + head_dim non-divisible case. tagged @eng-runtime @eng-runtime-infra

maria: temporary mitigation: pin default for suspected cases in rollout config to sdpa_v2 for dedicated and private customers until autotune patched. add rollout note in console.

sam: agreed. i'll do a tiny canary change: add a rule in the routing policy: if head_dim % 16 != 0 AND causal AND kv_cache_hit AND seq_len >= 1024 -> prefer sdpa_v2. will run canary on 3 hosts.

anya: thanks. also adding an e2e smoke to CI that runs the harness with head_dim=30/46 etc to catch regressions early.

perf-bot: deploy-plan: canary 3 hosts -> observe 2h -> global rollout if p50 within 5% baseline. tracked as DEPLOY-2971

dmitri: followup: let's add a lightweight trace that records actual memcpy counts and whether kernel uses a causal padding slowpath. that will make autotuner smarter without requiring large traces.

anya: done, sending PR with instrumentation now: https://redwood.company/pr/5589 — includes a metric `kernel.causal_slowpath_count` and emits tags (kernel, head_dim_mod16, kv_cache_hit).

maria: nice. once PR lands we can re-run the probe harness and update the picker score aggregation to weight real-path observations more than microprobe numbers.

sam: thumbs up. thanks team. anyone want to pair on analyzing the artifact?

anya: @dmitri i'll ping you in 30 for artifact walk-through.

maria: also leave a note in the release notes describing this edgecase so customers who run weird head sizes don't get surprised.

sam: adding a short blurb to the changelog now. :memo:

anya: keeping thread updated with canary numbers. current plan: monitor 2h after canary -> rollback if p50 > baseline + 5% or p99 > baseline + 10%

perf-bot: note: historical alerts suppressed for DEPLOY-2971 until canary completes to avoid noise.
